preloadGameClient defaults false in ClientConfig. Actual historical remote/regional override availability is not established; unused preload branches are not promoted as default behavior.
Native GFx sends Press_Continue, but its C++ sink and exact process-exit/IPC linkage are not qualified. The AIR stopped/crashed/abandoned handlers are separate verified definitions.
Historical logs self-report build4.20 and include later filenames; they do not establish deployment date, old runtime binary SHA, a complete3v3 match, or successful AIR stats retrieval.
Native player loading progress percentages and all-player readiness sequencing are not qualified by resource-loading messages or updater install progress.
InGameController.deactivate compares currentState==connected then discards the result (AVM2 equals/pop), not a reset assignment. Preserve this original source behavior.
Original processMessageHeader checks size/version and types>40 but does not reject negative types/payload sizes. No stronger native validation is inferred or implemented by this inventory.
Current Rust process state playing is not proof of transport/asset/graphical readiness; failed-exit errors take precedence over the reconnecting label while can_resume may remain true.

Current timeline starts from first immutable result reception; original engine timers, full ceremony rendering/audio, network protocol compatibility and original AIR runtime are not qualified by this inventory.
